players.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
players.summary: Ryan Jeffers remains on the IL with a fractured left hamate bone that required surgery. He's expected to miss 6-8 weeks and unlikely to return before early July.

sources.title: Ryan Jeffers Diagnosed With Hamate Fracture - MLB Trade Rumors

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper went 0-for-3 in the Phillies' 9-1 series finale loss to the Dodgers as Yamamoto was dominant with 10 strikeouts. Phillies dropped 2 of 3 in LA.

sources.title: Phillies vs. Dodgers (May 31, 2026) Box Score - ESPN

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez contributed 2 RBI and 2 runs in the Giants' 19-6 rout of the Rockies at Coors Field. His season batting average now sits around .327, maintaining his All-Star-caliber contact approach.

sources.title: Giants vs. Rockies (May 31, 2026) Box Score - ESPN

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went hitless (0-for-3) as the Mets completed a dominant 3-game sweep of the Marlins 10-1. He's batting .223 this season with 5 HR and 27 RBI.

sources.title: Marlins vs. Mets (May 31, 2026) Box Score - ESPN

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle singled, walked, and stole his 9th base (perfect 9-for-9 this season) in the Tigers' 2-1 loss to the White Sox. He signed an 8-year, $150M extension in April and is batting around .291.

sources.title: White Sox 2, Tigers 1 recap - Bless You Boys

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA went 1-for-4 in Sunday's 5-1 series finale loss to the Cardinals, a day after a career night (4-for-5, HR, 2 R, 2 RBI). He's now at 7 HR and slashing .239/.327/.391 on the season.

sources.title: Cubs vs. Cardinals (May 31, 2026) Box Score - ESPN

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill went 2-for-4 with 2 singles but was caught stealing in the 9th inning to end the game as the Padres lost 4-2 to close out a frustrating May series in Washington.

sources.title: Padres wrap mediocre May with series loss to Nationals

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernandez remains on the 10-day IL with a Grade 1 left hamstring strain suffered against Colorado on May 27. MRI results were encouraging and a mid-June return is possible.

sources.title: Teoscar Hernandez expected to miss 1 month with hamstring strain - Yahoo Sports

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams did not appear in the Mets' 10-1 blowout win. He's been settling in as closer recently after a rough start to the 2026 season, with multiple consecutive scoreless outings.

sources.title: Mets' Devin Williams finding his groove in 2026 - MLB.com

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler was off rotation Sunday, having started Friday May 29 (6 IP, 4 ER, 4 solo HR allowed in a PHI win). Next start projected around June 3. Season ERA is a sparkling 1.89 in 9 starts.

sources.title: Zack Wheeler Has Atypical Start in Phillies Loss to Dodgers - Yahoo Sports

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans suffered a setback in his rehab from a left elbow impingement (valgus extension overload) and was shut down for 2-3 days for re-evaluation. He's been on the IL since May 7 and his return timeline is uncertain.

sources.title: Cole Ragans has setback in rehab from elbow injury - MLB.com

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns was off rotation Sunday and is scheduled to start June 1 vs Kansas City. He's the NL leader in pitching WAR with a 1.99 ERA, allowing 2 or fewer runs in 9 of 10 starts this season.

sources.title: Chase Burns, your National League leader in pitching WAR - Red Reporter

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi was off rotation Sunday as Jack Leiter started Texas' 6-3 win over KC. He recently missed a start with left side tightness but returned and is listed day-to-day.

sources.title: Rangers' Nathan Eovaldi scratched due to left side tightness - ESPN

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan was off rotation Sunday (Yamamoto started the Dodgers' 9-1 win). He starts June 1 at Arizona vs Eduardo Rodriguez. Season line: 3-1, 4.70 ERA in 10 starts.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers was off rotation Sunday and is slated to start June 1 vs the Mariners. His last start was a career-high 14 strikeouts over 8 scoreless innings vs Texas on May 24.

sources.title: Reid Detmers hits new career-high in Angels' walk-off win

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice had a massive 4-for-5, 4-RBI game (double and triple) as the Yankees erupted for 13 runs in the 3rd inning — the first time in AL history — in a 13-8 win over the Athletics.

sources.title: Yankees catcher Ben Rice after 4-hit performance - ClutchPoints
